business_summary: Nextware Ltd. engages in the solutions and entertainment businesses in Japan. The company offers SAFR facial recognition platform, an AI facial recognition platform; WinActor and UiPath, a robotic process automation tool; blockchain and secret sharing technology; Microsoft 365 operational support; DX promotion; and factory operation data analysis. It is also involved in the provision of computer system design and software development work, computer system operation management and support, business and computer system consulting services; rental, sale, and import/export of computers and their peripherals; planning and operation contracting for various events; and non-life insurance agency business. Nextware Ltd. was incorporated in 1990 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.
